title: Maja Bjeljac — difference nav with a yellow underline
note: The wordmark top left and FOTO / VIDEO / VISUALS / INFO top right are white with mix-blend-mode: difference, so they read black on white and invert over the reel. Hover adds a 2px underline with no transition, drawn as a background gradient (linear-gradient(#FAEE11,#FAEE11) 0 100% / 1px 2px repeat-x), so through the blend it shows yellow on dark and blue on light. FOTO and VIDEO open small white tooltip boxes with three uppercase mono sub-links. Worth reusing: the underline trick, whose colour changes through the blend. It pairs with the kit's blend-nav block.
